panel.title: Invitations
panel.description: Send a link to the person who should join. They choose their own username and password, from any network.

empty.title: No invitations yet
empty.body: Invite a person to give them access without choosing their password for them.

panel.loadFailed: The invitations could not be loaded. Try again.
panel.noOrganisation: You do not manage any organisation, so you cannot invite anyone.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the invitation for {{name}}?
withdraw.body: The link and the code stop working at once. Whoever has them can no longer join.
withdraw.failed: The invitation was not withdrawn. It may have been used in the meantime.

create.title: Invite a person
create.description: You get a link and a code to send. The person chooses their own username and password.
create.name: Who is it for
create.nameHint: Optional. Only you see it, to recognise the invitation in the list.
create.failed: The invitation was not created. Try again.
create.forbidden: You cannot invite someone into this role.

result.title: Invitation ready
result.warning: Send the link or the code now: once you close this window you will not see them again.
result.codeHint: If the link does not open, the person goes to {{address}} and types this code.
result.qrAlt: QR code of the invitation link
result.qrHint: Or let the person frame this with their phone's camera.
result.expires: Valid until {{date}}, for one person only.

accept.title: Join NeroNet
accept.subtitle: Someone has invited you. Choose the username and the password you will sign in with.
accept.fromLink: Your invitation is in the link you opened.
accept.codeHint: 12 letters and numbers, for example 7K3M-Q9TD-X2WA. It is in the message from whoever invited you.
accept.usernameHint: 3 to 64 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
accept.passwordHint: A long phrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.

errors.usernameFormat: Use 3 to 64 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore, starting with a letter or a number.
errors.usernameTaken: This username is already taken. Choose another one.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.invalid: This invitation does not work: it may have expired, been used already or been withdrawn. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts from this network. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: The account was not created. Try again.

ready.title: Your account is ready
ready.mfa: Your role needs an authenticator app on your phone. Sign in and follow the steps to set it up.
ready.plain: Sign in with the username and the password you just chose.

signedIn.body: You are signed in as {{name}}. To use this invitation for a new account, sign out first.
